file_change.purpose: Execute mechanically runnable validation explicitly prescribed by an accepted Plan and produce deterministic validation results for Build Conformance evidence.
implementation: Derive required validation identities from the accepted file realization plans.
Resolve required validation identities against the accepted Plan validation document.
Execute only mechanically executable validation kinds defined by Core.
Require every selected executable validation to declare a non-empty command.
Execute validation from the explicit repository root with deterministic environment controls and a bounded timeout.
Capture command, return code, stdout, stderr, and disposition as deterministic validation results.
Reject required mechanical validation that fails or times out.
Do not perform semantic Assurance in the validation runner.
